name: Creative Australia
note: Primary AU source. Drupal, server-rendered, not Cloudflare-blocked. Custom paginated parser. Every item is Australian-eligible arts funding.

name: Neon Marketplace
note: Disabled. Listing is mostly stallholder calls, vendor EOIs and community events. Only ~2 real arts opportunities per 10 items across multiple pages. Too noisy for the HTTP overhead of fetching each detail page before classification.

name: ArtsHub Opportunities
note: Disabled: artshub.com.au/opportunity/ is Cloudflare-blocked for plain HTTP requests. HTML scraper cannot reach it.

name: Calendar for Artists
note: Australian art competitions/prizes calendar (The Events Calendar plugin). Covers independent and regional prizes. Community-submitted, so not exhaustive.

name: Artsoz prize registry
note: Reads Artsoz's structured list of major Australian prizes (official URLs + state/medium metadata) and scrapes each official site for live dates. Heaviest source; grows as Artsoz adds prizes. URL overrides applied for Kangaroo Valley (real site is artsinthevalley.net.au) and Churchie (real entry site is churchie.com.au).

name: ArtsHub
note: Disabled permanently. The main /feed/ is 200 news articles with no structured opportunity data. Opportunity-specific feeds (/opportunity/feed/, ?post_type=opportunity) return 403 Cloudflare challenge even with browser User-Agent. Not a viable source.

name: Artshow.com Competitions
note: Clean feed of juried competitions and prizes. Amount and deadline already in each description.

name: Artshow.com International
note: Overlaps the competitions feed; dedup merges identical links automatically.

name: Colossal
note: Disabled. Feed is 10 art journalism items per run, no opportunities. All correctly tagged Other by the classifier but costs API calls for zero useful output.

name: e-flux announcements
note: International prizes and open calls. Confirm the exact feed path before enabling.

name: Urunga Small Sculpture Prize
note: Registry page source. Judges subpage has full details including judge bios, prize amounts and deadline.

name: Paddington Art Prize
note: Registry: standalone prize site. Painting $30k + sculpture $10k, closes early Aug.

name: Google: Australian art prizes
queries: Australian art prize entries open 2026 site:.au
"art prize" OR "art award" "entries close" OR "entries open" 2026 Australia visual
Australian visual art prize competition 2026 open entries deadline
note: Daily Google search via Serper API. Requires SERPER_API_KEY in .env (free at serper.dev, 2500 free searches). Surfaces prize pages not covered by other sources. Aggregator domains are excluded to avoid duplicates.
